title: Bosses and their rules
text: A boss can lose only a fraction of its maximum health each second (6% by default), so no blow kills it at once. Bosses never regenerate on their own and never use Unique or Ultimate skills. Their aura can briefly put a nearby player's Ultimate on a 2-3 s cooldown (Anti-Magic users are exempt). Boss bars are custom. The Tier List bosses (F to higher tiers), D&D bosses and the arc characters of Black Clover, Seven Deadly Sins and DanMachi live in the dungeons. Numbers: the fastest kill of a plain boss takes about 17 seconds (6% a second, at least 20 health per second, 1.5 times in the final phase). Black Clover bosses have three times health and damage. See Bosses: tiers, damage cap and Black Clover.
